LanguageData.LP_MythalGate.label: mythal gate
LanguageData.LP_MythalGate.description:
A stone archway built jointly by ancient elves and the Netherese, with a lost mythal buried beneath. The city the mythal guarded is long gone, and the ward is now just a labyrinth that reassembles itself: each floor collapses once solved, and after being sealed for a few days it weaves the next floor in a new shape, going ever deeper with no end.

Defeat the guardian on each floor and whoever solves it gets adventurer XP, mythal shards and treasure; every 10 floors there's a milestone boss. Mythal shards can be exchanged for supplies at the gate.

The mythal gate can't be deconstructed, moved or damaged.
LanguageData.LP_MythalExit.label: mythal echo
LanguageData.LP_MythalExit.description: An echo within the mythal ward: from here you can return directly to the mythal gate on the surface.
LanguageData.LP_MythalWall.label: mythal stone wall
LanguageData.LP_MythalWall.description: A stone wall congealed from the mythal ward, warm to the touch. Can't be mined or broken.
LanguageData.LP_MythalLamp.label: mythal lamp
LanguageData.LP_MythalLamp.description: A cluster of pale blue mythal crystals that glow on their own.
LanguageData.LP_MythalFountain.label: mythal spring
LanguageData.LP_MythalFountain.description: A clear spring welling up within the mythal ward. Those who walk to it have their wounds healed and fatigue swept away, once per person per floor.
LanguageData.LP_MythalShard.label: mythal shard
LanguageData.LP_MythalShard.description: A pale blue crystal shard that falls when a mythal ward collapses. Can only be exchanged for things at the mythal gate; traders don't accept it.
